Here incompressibility means $\operatorname{div}u=\operatorname{tr}L=0$. For any finite continuous viscosity $\eta:[0,\infty)\to[0,\infty)$ and the stress law $\tau=2\eta(\dot\gamma)D$, one has $\tau:D\ge0$. Under a $C^2$ rigid change of observer $x^*=Q(t)x+c(t)$, where $Q(t)\in SO(3)$, the transformed rate of strain is $D^*=QDQ^{\mathsf T}$, so the transformed stress is $\tau^*=Q\tau Q^{\mathsf T}$.
